help_text:
📖 *TruthTellerBot Help*

🔍 *Features:*
• Track message edits
• Track message deletions
• Save deleted media
• Real-time notifications

⚙️ *Setup:*
1\. Telegram > Settings > Business
2\. Chat Bots > Add Bot
3\. Select this bot

🎯 *Commands:*
/start — start & help
/get\_latest\_media — get latest media file
/help — this help
/set\_language — change language
/premium — get premium access
/referral — get referral link

⚠️ *Important:*
The bot does not save messages. All notifications are sent only to this chat.
